mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_borrow (student_id, book_id, borrow_date, return_date, status, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{bookId}, #{borrowDate}, #{returnDate}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE book_borrow SET return_date = #{returnDate}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM book_borrow WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM book_borrow WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY borrow_date DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book_borrow WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT bb.id, bb.student_id, bb.book_id, bb.borrow_date, bb.return_date, bb.status, b.book_name, b.author, b.isbn FROM book_borrow bb LEFT JOIN book b ON bb.book_id = b.id AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE bb.student_id = #{studentId} AND bb.deleted = 0 ORDER BY bb.borrow_date DESC

SELECT bb.id, bb.student_id, bb.book_id, bb.borrow_date, bb.return_date, bb.status, s.name as student_name, s.student_no, b.book_name, b.author, b.isbn FROM book_borrow bb LEFT JOIN student s ON bb.student_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN book b ON bb.book_id = b.id AND b.deleted = 0 WHERE bb.id = #{id} AND bb.deleted = 0
